messages:
peter_research: Hey @maria_peopleops quick question 914 9373fb04bb 4dd4c5. I was sick during Performance Review Week (Feb 12	6) and our team had a review blackout (Feb 13	6) so I couldn't take PTO. My balance shows those 2 days as used. Can we request a carryover or exception?

maria_peopleops: hey @peter_research sorry to hear you were ill 622. Performance review blackouts are about scheduling, not excused absences. For documented illness we do allow exceptions. Please submit the "Leave Exception" form in the People Portal and attach a medical note or doctor's note.

maria_peopleops: TL;DR: 1) manager sign-off required, 2) People Ops reviews docs and posts retro adjustment to the leave ledger, 3) if payroll already closed we'll correct the ledger and coordinate with payroll for any cash impact. Deadline for exception requests related to the prior calendar year is Feb 28.

olivia_manager: I can confirm I'll approve once @peter_research uploads. @peter_research fyi I blocked your review week dates on the team calendar as "excused" so there's manager confirmation in the portal flow.

peter_research: thx @olivia_manager and @maria_peopleops. Two extra Qs: a) I used a half-day sick on Feb 12 and a full day on Feb 14 (which was inside the blackout). Does People Ops handle half-days? b) If approved, does that count against my 5-day carryover cap?

maria_peopleops: good questions. a) yes we track hours; submit the note and indicate hours in the form (e.g., 4 hours). We'll restore hours rather than rounding to full days. b) approvals for documented medical leave don't count toward the discretionary extra carryover that managers sometimes request, but restored hours will increase your active balance and therefore subject to normal year-end carryover caps. We can annotate the ledger entry for audit to show it was a medical restoration.

hr-bot: People Portal form "Leave Exception (Illness/Bereavement)": https://people.redwoodinference.com/forms/leave-exception (auto message).

peter_research: uploaded doctor's note and indicated 4 hours on Feb 12 + 8 hours on Feb 14. Submitted manager approval request to @olivia_manager.

maria_peopleops: Received docs. I'll review and if everything's in order will route a retro adjustment to payroll. Note: if payroll has already issued a PTO payout on separation we handle cash differences separately; for active employees we typically do ledger restores. Expect confirmation here within 7 business days.

olivia_manager: Approved in portal. I also left a comment noting this overlaps review blackout and to treat as excused.

peter_research: Appreciate it, thanks team :heart:

maria_peopleops: All set 44d, ledger updated and payroll notified. You should see the restored 12 hours in your next accrual statement. If anything looks off DM me.
